settings.title: Settings
settings.languageFooter: You can also choose the language in the iPhone Settings app, under Apps › Signet.
settings.systemSettingsFooter: Language, location, photos, camera, microphone and Face ID access for Signet.
settings.privateLockHint: Ask for Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.
settings.appIconFooter: Choose the icon shown on your Home Screen.
settings.appIconExpoGo: App icons can't be changed in Expo Go. Install the app on your device to choose one.
settings.appIconUnsupported: Your device doesn't support alternate app icons.
settings.languageFooterAndroid: You can also choose the language in Android Settings, under Apps › Signet › Language.
settings.systemSettingsFooterAndroid: Language, location, camera, microphone and notification access for Signet.
settings.privateLockHintAndroid: Ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
settings.privateLockUnavailableAndroid: Not available: set up a fingerprint, face unlock or a screen lock on this device first.
settings.appIconFooterAndroid: Choose the icon shown on your home screen. Your launcher may take a moment to update it.
settings.appIconConfirmBody: Android may close Signet to apply the new icon. Your tabs are kept: open the app again from its new icon.
settings.openLinksInNewTab: Open links in a new tab
settings.searchEngineFooter: Used when you type a search in the address bar.
settings.homepageUrlInvalid: Enter a valid web address, like example.com.
settings.homepageFooter: New tabs open on this page.
settings.contentBlockingFooter: Blocks ads and trackers before they load, using the EasyList and EasyPrivacy filter lists (GPL-3.0 / CC BY-SA 3.0, easylist.to). In Expo Go, only common ads are hidden. A few may still get through.
settings.privateLockUnavailable: Not available: set up Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode on this device first.
settings.searchSuggestionsFooter: Shows suggestions from your search engine as you type. What you type is sent to the search engine to get them. Not used in private tabs.

data.intro: Choose what to remove from this device.
data.thumbnailsHint: Cached images shown in the tab switcher.
data.siteDataUnavailable: Can't be cleared from this version of the app.
data.siteDataHint: Signs you out of websites and removes their saved data.
data.confirmMessage: This can't be undone. Bookmarks and settings are kept.
data.limits: Cookies and site data are kept by your device's web engine, and this version of the app runs inside Expo Go, which can't clear them. To leave no trace, use private tabs: they never store anything.

about.tagline: A calm, fast browser with spaces for every part of your life.

transfer.exportHint: Save a file you can open in any browser.
transfer.importHint: Add bookmarks from an HTML file exported by another browser.
transfer.footer: Imported bookmarks go into a new folder, so nothing is overwritten.
transfer.exportEmpty: You have no bookmarks to export.
transfer.shareUnavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
transfer.importNone: No bookmarks found in this file.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.subtitle: A calm, fast browser with spaces for every part of your life.
onboarding.welcomeBody: A calm, fast browser that stays out of your way.
onboarding.spacesTitle: A space for every part of life
onboarding.spacesBody: Keep work, home and projects apart, each with its own tabs and colour.
onboarding.privacyBody: Private tabs leave no history, and content blocking quiets ads and trackers.
onboarding.personalizeBody: Pick a search engine and a look. You can change both any time in Settings.

passwords.title: Passwords
passwords.offerFooter: After you sign in to a site, Signet offers to save the password. Passwords are stored in the device Keychain and are unlocked with Face ID. Private tabs never offer to save.
passwords.fillFailed: No sign-in field found on this page.
passwords.lockedMessage: Unlock with Face ID to see your saved passwords.
passwords.unavailable: Secure storage isn't available on this device.
passwords.emptyFooter: No saved passwords yet. They appear here when you save one from a page or import a file.
passwords.neverEmpty: Sites where you choose “Never for this site” appear here.
passwords.neverFooter: Signet doesn't offer to save passwords on these sites. Remove a site to be asked again.
passwords.copiedPassword: Password copied, it will be cleared from the clipboard in 60 seconds
passwords.copyFooter: A copied password is cleared from the clipboard after 60 seconds.
passwords.transferFooter: Use a CSV file exported from Apple Passwords, Chrome, Firefox or another password manager. Delete the file once you have imported it.
passwords.importHint: Existing passwords are kept as they are.
passwords.importNone: No passwords found in this file.
passwords.importFormat: This file isn't a password export (no URL and password columns).
passwords.exportHint: A file with your passwords in plain text.
passwords.exportWarning: The file contains all your passwords in plain text. Anyone who gets it can read them. Delete it as soon as you are done.

link.title: Computers
link.syncFooter: Opens the websites you run on your computer, on this phone, and sends pages between the two. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing goes through the internet.
link.unavailable: Not available in Expo Go. Install the app on your phone to link a computer.
link.invalidHint: {{name}} no longer knows this phone. Remove the link, then pair again from the computer.
link.forgetBody: The link is deleted on this phone, and on the computer if it is connected. To use it again, pair it again.
link.forgottenThere: {{name}} removed the link with this phone
link.localhostChoose: Choose the computer that serves localhost on this phone.
link.localhostOne: Addresses like localhost:5173 open the site running on this computer.
link.unsupported: This version of the system can't send localhost to your computer. You can still send pages and see the dev servers.
link.cameraAsk: Signet uses the camera to read the code shown by your computer.
link.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Turn it on in the system settings.
link.scanHint: On your computer, open Signet and show the pairing code. Point the camera at it.
link.confirmBody: This phone will be able to open the websites running on this computer, and send pages to it. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi.
link.pairedBody: Your computer and this phone are now linked.

pairError.expired: The code has expired. Show a new one on your computer.
pairError.used: The code was already used or is no longer valid. Show a new one on your computer.
pairError.version: The apps aren't on the same version. Update Signet on both.
pairError.pin: This computer's identity doesn't match the code. Show a new code.
pairError.unreachable: The computer can't be reached. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi.

tunnel.port-closed: Nothing is listening on port {{port}} of {{name}}
